integrity: The graph, nerve convention, facets, incidence matching and collapse certificates are specified in RESULT.md and can be checked by verify.py. The 2014 Petersen vertex-neighborhood homology and the general 2022 facet lemma are credited as prior work.
scientific_limitations: Finite Petersen graph only; complete finite discrete-Morse certificate and homotopy proof, with no assertion about generalized Petersen graphs. Independent external validation not performed; an unindexed prior equivalent computation may exist.
title: Complete graph Čech persistence of the Petersen graph
